title: Crisis, Coup, Fragmentation, Recombination & Recovery
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only projection over explicit visible canonical-owner crisis/coup/split/fragmentation/recombination/recovery event evidence without auto-adjudicating outcomes, mutating faction/member/relationship/leadership/resource/Project/time/owner truth or creating a duplicate political-event ledger.

resolved_contract.owner_rule: Every accepted ODL-06 observation is explicit owner evidence carrying organization/subject, event kind, canonical event reference, owner authority/reference, profile/context, provenance and visibility references. An observed row also carries an opaque canonical owner event-state reference. ODL-06 defines no universal crisis phase, coup threshold, fragmentation trigger, recombination rule or recovery formula and does not replace canonical owner truth.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: Visibility filtering occurs first. Observations are grouped by canonical event reference. A group resolves only when compatible visible observed evidence agrees on event kind, canonical event-state reference and profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown evidence remains unknown; incompatible-only remains incompatible; divergent visible kind/state/profile/context tuples or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. Canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
resolved_contract.advisory_rule: Visible ODL-02 pressure, ODL-03 politics, ODL-04 role/succession and ODL-05 resource/maintenance/admin outputs are separately labeled advisory context only. They never synthesize an ODL-06 event, advance an event state, trigger crisis/coup/split/fragmentation/recombination/recovery, or impose an action restriction.
resolved_contract.succession_rule: ODL-04 remains succession/leadership projection authority. ODL-06 may surface visible ODL-04 succession context only as advisory evidence and never appoints, removes or replaces leadership.
resolved_contract.time_rule: Owner event-state references are explicit evidence only. Wall-clock time, projected elapsed time and Project scheduling never advance an ODL-06 event or campaign time.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized crisis, faction, relationship, leadership, resource, Project, advisory, profile/context, provenance and permission evidence is filtered before events, states, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.mutation_rule: No crisis/coup/split/fragmentation/recombination/recovery/succession adjudication; no faction/member/relationship/reputation/leadership/resource/Project/time/owner mutation; no command authority, system permission or canonical write is performed.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-06 persistence or duplicate political-event/faction/relationship/succession/permission ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.validation: Acceptance first; genuine self-hosted RED while production contract/panel are absent; exactly one ODL-06 current-family Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout; final exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.

MIB-09 remains relationship/reputation/faction social-runtime authority; Character-Actors remains actor identity/agency authority; APW-D26 remains Project/time authority; DPL/WCI and Permission/visibility remain unchanged.
